statement_en: Fix an integer m ≥ 0 and consider m residue classes u_j (mod q_j), j = 1, …, m, where every modulus q_j is a positive integer and the moduli are allowed to repeat. Suppose that some block of 2^m consecutive integers lies entirely inside the union of these m classes. Show that then every integer lies in one of the classes.
statement_lean:
theorem erdos_80317
    (m : ℕ) (u : Fin m → ℤ) (q : Fin m → ℕ)
    (hq : ∀ j, 0 < q j)
    (hblock : ∃ t : ℤ, ∀ k : ℕ, k < 2 ^ m →
      ∃ j : Fin m, (q j : ℤ) ∣ (t + (k : ℤ) - u j)) :
    ∀ z : ℤ, ∃ j : Fin m, (q j : ℤ) ∣ (z - u j) := by
  sorry
